단발 동작의 프레임 고르기: 1이면 움직임이 많은 곳에 몰아서 / 0이면 시간 간격으로 고르게

value: The attached image is the ground of the game map, and these objects will be placed directly on it. Paint every object so that it looks like it stands in that exact place at night, in the same hand-painted anime background style as the ground: soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per surface and thin dark navy outlines (never pure black, never thick). Color grading: a moonless night lit only by dim cool ambient light, so every local color is strongly desaturated and shifted toward the same slate-blue and blue-gray range as the ground. Objects are mid-dark, only a little lighter than the ground, so their silhouettes read clearly without popping out. No bright colors, no saturated colors, no white highlights and no daylight look anywhere, except for small parts that are explicitly described as glowing.
